name: upres-cli
description: UpRes MCP server: list models, query credits, submit 4K image and video upscale jobs via the UpRes API.
long_description: UpRes MCP server: list models, query credits, submit 4K image and video upscale jobs via the UpRes API. Tools: upres_list_models, upres_get_credits, upres_upscale_image, upres_upscale_video, upres_get_job.

api_key.title: UpRes API key
api_key.description: UpRes API key from https://upres.ai/account — required for upscale and credit tools.

tools.name: upres_list_models
tools.description: List UpRes upscale models (flare, prism, lumen, mirage, motion, motion-x) with use cases.

tools.name: upres_get_credits
tools.description: Show recent job count for the authenticated UpRes API key as a quota proxy.

tools.name: upres_upscale_image
tools.description: Submit an image upscale job from a public URL. Models: flare, prism, lumen, mirage.

tools.name: upres_upscale_video
tools.description: Submit a video upscale job from a public URL. Models: motion, motion-x.

tools.name: upres_get_job
tools.description: Get status and result_url of an UpRes job by id.
